purpose: Measure source-backed whole-waveform cadence sensitivity at fixed ODE tolerance, comparing exact shared samples on successively finer output charts. The fine NQC input spacing follows output_step/32, as in the current runner.
interpretation: A combined output-cadence and fine NQC input-spacing self-convergence test; it does not isolate one from the other. Passing would not establish independent reference fidelity, NR accuracy, full-domain behavior, gradients, or ROM qualification.
